decisions.reason: As a 2023 launch with its own webpage, it reflects visible investment and public commitment, so management is likely to give it more time and treat any weak uptake as temporary.
The firm has publicly backed this product on a dedicated page and it fits the broader location-based energy pricing theme, which encourages continued support despite early uncertainty.
Because it was launched only recently and showcased prominently, management is likely to justify prior investment by keeping it on the market for another year.
Although it belongs to the same strategic cluster, it had only limited website visibility and overlaps with more prominently presented tariff tools, making it the easiest product to discontinue.
Its own page signals a stronger public commitment, and as a supporting regional tool it likely reinforces the rest of the product set, which favors persistence.
With only a website mention and substantial overlap with the firm's other energy comparison offers, it has the weakest visible commitment and is most exposed if portfolio simplification occurs.
